title: Snapshot sets
description: Reviewed disk-only snapshots for the exact deployed QEMU guests. No automatic rollback or deletion.
working: Reading or submitting the reviewed operation…
busy: A deployment operation is active. Saved results and task reconciliation remain available.
name: Set name
policy: Keep at least {count} completed sets or sets younger than {days} days. Each deletion needs separate confirmation; review remaining candidates again after completion.
nonAtomic: Each VM has its own outcome. This is not an atomic operation and does not guarantee application consistency.
rollbackWarning: Rollback replaces guest disks and configuration. Guests are left stopped; application recovery must be verified separately.
deleteWarning: Delete only the listed owned native snapshots. This cannot be undone.
empty: No saved snapshot sets on this page.
noCandidates: No completed sets qualify for retention deletion.
cancelled: Unused plans cancelled; no guest mutation was sent.
oldBinding: This history belongs to an older revision or target. Restore the original binding before recovery.
operatorRecovery: Operator recovery required: the native write outcome is unknown. Task adoption is unavailable; the deployment lock stays held. Do not repeat the write.

errors.context: The backend, credentials or deployment changed. Refresh and review again.
errors.invalid: The backend returned an invalid snapshot review. Refresh before continuing.
errors.stale: This review expired or was already submitted. Request a new review.
errors.auth: The backend denied access. Check your API connection and permissions.
errors.blocked: The operation was refused because ownership, target, policy or active work changed. Refresh and review again.
errors.unconfirmed: The request outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh saved results; do not repeat a submitted write.
